customers_say: Customers find the smart door lock to be of good quality and worth its price, with straightforward installation and reliable performance. They appreciate its comprehensive features and ease of use, while also noting its stylish appearance. Customers value its security features, with one customer specifically mentioning the anti-pry/tamper alarm.

reviews.title: Excellent Product, Smart Features, and Fantastic Support!
reviews.body: After months of searching for the perfect smart lock, I finally settled on the LAVNA LA24 (LA44). What completely won me over was its brilliant connectivity feature—the ability to seamlessly handle mobile app, Wi-Fi, and Bluetooth operations directly without the hassle or extra cost of needing a separate bridge. It solves a massive pain point that many other brands complicate. reviews.title: Solid smart lock, a few rough edges
reviews.body: Been using the LAVNA smart lock on my main wooden door for a while now. Installation was straightforward and the fingerprint sensor is genuinely fast and accurate. Having the built-in camera plus RFID card, PIN, and manual key backup means I’m never locked out even if the battery dies or the app acts up.
